name: An unforgettable date
source:
You wake up in a strange place with a strange looking girl in front of you.

You don't remember how you got there or who you are.

Talk to her and try to get to know each other, don't talk at all or just run away from her.

What will you do?

[From [url=https://blue-strawberry.itch.io/an-unforgettable-date]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你在一个陌生的地方醒来，面前站着一个模样古怪的女孩。

你不记得自己怎么来到这里，也不记得自己是谁。

你可以与她交谈，试着互相了解；也可以一句话也不说，或干脆从她身边逃走。

你会怎么做？

[摘自[url=https://blue-strawberry.itch.io/an-unforgettable-date]Itch.io[/url]]
